title: Temperature
summary: Extended-range forecasts point to highs of ~34–35°C (94–95°F) and overnight lows of ~25–26°C (77–79°F) on all three days — typical for Trincomalee in August. Treat this as directional, not exact, since it's still more than a week out.

title: Rain
summary: August is climatologically one of the driest months on the east coast; expect mostly dry, sunny conditions with only a small chance of a brief shower.

title: Sun & daylight
summary: Sunrise ≈ 5:56–5:58 AM, sunset ≈ 6:14–6:21 PM. UV index peaks 10 AM–4 PM — Pigeon Island lands in the cool morning window on Day 1, and kayaking runs mid-afternoon on Day 2, comfortably clear of sunset.

title: Sea / Pigeon Island
summary: Trincomalee's boat/snorkelling season runs May–September, with June–August generally rated the calmest, clearest stretch of the year (the rough-sea, boat-suspension risk period is the Oct–Mar northeast monsoon, which doesn't apply here). Conditions for 26 August should be favourable, but it's still worth a same-day check with the boat operator, since local wind can pick up.

title: Tides
summary: Sri Lanka's east coast has a modest tidal range; it isn't a major factor for either Pigeon Island snorkelling or the beaches on this trip.
